fact: Mali's Council of Ministers on 9 October 2026 took note of a written communication saying the 4th Schema Directeur de la Statistique and its 2026-2030 action plan have been drawn up as the reference framework, after earlier schemas adopted in 2006, 2014 and 2020; it records no adoption.

fact: INSTAT held the 17th technical session of the annual review of the Schema Directeur de la Statistique on 13-14 August 2026 in Bamako, assessing statistical activities and the implementation of the 2025 review's recommendations.
The review session is stated to take place with a view to the adoption of SDS IV 2026-2030, which is not yet stated adopted.
INSTAT describes the Schema Directeur de la Statistique (SDS IV) as the roadmap guiding the national statistical system, in force in February 2026; the document gives no period.

fact: The 'Programmes statistiques' specialised commission of the Conseil National de la Statistique met on 17 February 2026 to monitor SDS IV, assessed progress on the 2025 statistical review recommendations, validated the 2025 action-plan scorecard and updated the action-plan trajectory for the whole SDS IV.
